name: Group Owners Workflow Template
description: Delegated group membership, subgroup, and ownership management for designated Looker Group Owners.

ownership_attribute_name.description: Looker User Attribute set on target groups specifying owners in canonical 'u:<id>,g:<id>' format

include_subgroups.description: When true, owners of a parent group can also view and manage its descendant child subgroups

user_id_limitation.description: Limitation enforcing which users can be discovered and added to owned groups or assigned as group owners

mode.description: 'exclude_privileged' (default) allows all users except Looker Admins and Service Accounts; 'none' allows all users; 'scope_groups_minus_privileged' restricts to active scope groups excluding Looker Admins and Service Accounts; 'scope_groups' restricts to active scope groups; 'self' restricts to the invoking user

attribute_name.description: User attribute name set on Looker Groups for Scope Group matching when mode is scope_groups*

memberships.description: Controls for managing user memberships, group owners, and child subgroups within owned groups
